## AI-enabled engineering in practice

Rodrigo has been increasingly using AI as part of the engineering loop rather than only as a chat assistant. Examples:

- codebase analysis
- implementation planning
- coding agents
- debugging
- test generation/validation
- documentation
- product ideation
- release/store content
- workflow automation

Positioning (important, do not simplify to "AI writes code for me"):

> AI increases engineering leverage while the engineer remains accountable for architecture, correctness, security and production behavior.
